title: PainDraw drawing, schema 1.0
description: One pain drawing as written by paindrawEM, paindraw_shiny and read by paindrawR. Files without schema_version are the old v0.3 format and are not covered by this schema. Extra keys are allowed at all levels and are ignored by readers.

schema_version.description: Version of the JSON format (major.minor), independent of the module version.

module_version.description: Version number of the app that wrote the file, e.g. "1.0.0".

app.description: Name of the app that wrote the file, e.g. "paindrawEM" or "paindraw_shiny".

drawing_id.description: Id of the drawing. paindrawEM writes PID<project>-R<record>-F<field>-E<event>-I<instance>, but any non-empty string is valid.

timestamp.description: Time the drawing was saved, ISO 8601. Writers should use UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ); readers accept a space instead of T, missing seconds, fractional seconds, an offset or no time zone.

width.description: Canvas width in px (module setting canvas_width).

height.description: Canvas height in px (module setting canvas_height).

template_file.description: File name of the background image.

template_md5.description: MD5 of the background image, 32 lowercase hex characters.

strokes.description: Strokes in drawing order. May be empty in the schema; paindrawEM does not save empty drawings. stroke_id must be unique within a drawing; this is checked later in the pipeline, not by the schema.

spray_density.description: Integer >= 0 for spray, null for pen.

spray_radius.description: Integer >= 0 for spray, null for pen.

alpha.description: Opacity, 0-1 (0 = invisible, 1 = opaque). Any number of decimals.

points.description: [x, y] integer pairs in canvas px. May be negative or outside the canvas.
